description:
List compliance certifications (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA), optionally
narrowed by ``search`` across names, verbose names, and slugs. Use this to
resolve the opaque ``compliance_certification_ids`` that ``get_product``
returns to named certifications, and to enumerate which certifications the
catalog tracks.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's response.

search.description: Free-text search across names, slugs, and text.

name: list_compliance_certifications
title: List Compliance Certifications
